# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.0 Worker 3 (Slot 95 oe_aip_): 6 Dynamic Historical AI Personalities & Global Eurasian Diplomatic/Expansion Choreography (0 vanilla overrides, 0 ai_diplochance). Generated by gen_v120_epic_ai.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# O(1) triggers for Slot 95 Epic AI Personalities & Global Choreography (oe_aip_).

# ==============================================================================
# Rule #18 Wrapper Triggers (Stage Integrator wires oe_rule_is_world_concert_* here)
# global_var:oe_v120_rule_override:
#   unset/0 = follow Rule #18 (Standard pre-Stage)
#   1       = Standard (Full: Concert + Resolutions + Epic AI Personalities + Music)
#   2       = Concert Only (Disables Epic AI Personality Shifts; keeps choreography/Concert)
#   3       = Off (Silent compatibility: disables all Slot 95 actions & choreography)
# ==============================================================================

# Any scope. Rule #18 = Off.
oe_aip_rule_is_off = {
	OR = {
		global_var:oe_v120_rule_override ?= 3
		AND = {
			NOT = { global_var:oe_v120_rule_override ?= 1 }
			NOT = { global_var:oe_v120_rule_override ?= 2 }
			oe_rule_is_world_concert_off = yes
		}
	}
}

# Any scope. Epic AI personality shifting enabled (Rule #18 = Standard, not Concert-Only, not Off).
oe_aip_personality_enabled = {
	NOT = { oe_aip_rule_is_off = yes }
	NOT = { global_var:oe_v120_rule_override ?= 2 }
	NOT = { global_var:oe_v120_rule_override ?= 3 }
	OR = {
		global_var:oe_v120_rule_override ?= 1
		NOT = { oe_rule_is_world_concert_only = yes }
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Base AI & Fiscal-Austerity Yield Triggers (strictly yields to v9.9 oe_ai2_fiscal_austerity)
# ==============================================================================

# Country scope. Active independent non-rebel AI under Rule #18.
oe_aip_ai_active = {
	NOT = { oe_aip_rule_is_off = yes }
	is_ai = yes
	is_rebel_country = no
	is_subject = no
}

# Country scope. Ready for scripted expansion targets (healthy treasury & NOT in fiscal austerity).
oe_aip_ready_for_expansion = {
	NOT = { oe_aip_rule_is_off = yes }
	oe_ai2_ready_for_expansion = yes
	NOT = { ai_personality = ai_personality:oe_ai2_fiscal_austerity }
}

# Country scope. Master gate before Slot 95 may shift an AI's personality.
# STRICT YIELD: NEVER overwrites oe_ai2_fiscal_austerity or any country under fiscal crisis / high debt!
oe_aip_can_shift_personality = {
	oe_aip_personality_enabled = yes
	is_ai = yes
	is_rebel_country = no
	is_subject = no
	NOT = { has_game_rule = ai_personalities_random }
	NOT = { has_game_rule = oe_rule_hegemon_ai_off }
	oe_ai2_in_fiscal_crisis = no
	is_during_bankruptcy = no
	num_loans < 4
	NOT = { ai_personality = ai_personality:oe_ai2_fiscal_austerity }
	war_exhaustion < 8
	stability >= -10
}

# ==============================================================================
# Eurasian Concert & Anti-Hegemon Cross-Module Wrappers (null-safe pre-Concert & post-Stage)
# ==============================================================================

# Any scope. Eurasian Concert IO exists.
oe_aip_concert_exists = {
	exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
}

# Country scope. Member of the Eurasian Concert IO.
oe_aip_is_concert_member = {
	exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
	is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
}

# Country scope. Holds a Pentarchy permanent seat in the Eurasian Concert.
oe_aip_has_concert_pentarchy_seat = {
	exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
	is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
	international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
		country_has_special_status = {
			type = special_status:oe_con_pentarchy_seat
			country = prev
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Designated Treaty Buffer State in the Eurasian Concert.
oe_aip_is_concert_buffer = {
	exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
	is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
	international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
		country_has_special_status = {
			type = special_status:oe_con_neutral_buffer_member
			country = prev
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Subject to Eurasian Concert sovereignty restraint.
oe_aip_in_concert_sovereignty = {
	OR = {
		has_country_modifier = oe_con_concert_sovereignty_mod
		AND = {
			oe_aip_is_concert_member = yes
			OR = {
				oe_aip_has_concert_pentarchy_seat = yes
				current_year >= 1648
			}
		}
	}
}

# Country scope. Active balancing power under high hegemonic tension.
oe_aip_anti_hegemon_league_active = {
	OR = {
		has_country_modifier = oe_con_anti_hegemon_league_mod
		AND = {
			oe_heg2_tension_high = yes
			NOT = { oe_heg2_is_multi_hegemon = yes }
		}
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# Six Epic AI Personality Eligibility Triggers (Blueprint §4.2; Persia uses IRA)
# ==============================================================================

# 1. Imperial Restorer (BYZ / ROM / IRA / RUS / MOS / MNG / MCH pre-Age-5 consolidation)
oe_aip_elig_imperial_restorer = {
	stability >= 0
	country_rank_level >= 3
	current_year < 1680
	OR = {
		tag = BYZ
		tag = ROM
		tag = IRA
		tag = RUS
		tag = MOS
		tag = MNG
		tag = MCH
	}
}

# 2. Thalassocracy Hegemon (major maritime trading states with >= 6 ports or Naval Hegemon)
oe_aip_elig_thalassocracy_hegemon = {
	num_of_ports >= 6
	OR = {
		tag = POR
		tag = NED
		tag = HOL
		tag = GBR
		tag = ENG
		tag = VEN
		tag = GEN
		tag = MLC
		tag = ZMR
		oe_heg2_is_nav_hegemon = yes
	}
}

# 3. Celestial Suzerain (reigning Celestial Emperor outside severe crisis)
oe_aip_elig_celestial_suzerain = {
	oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
	war_exhaustion < 6
	stability >= -5
}

# 4. Gunpowder Conqueror (1440-1740 gunpowder surge powers or Military Hegemon)
oe_aip_elig_gunpowder_conqueror = {
	war_exhaustion < 4
	stability >= 0
	OR = {
		AND = {
			current_year >= 1440
			current_year <= 1740
			OR = {
				tag = TUR
				tag = TIM
				tag = MUG
				tag = ODA
				tag = JAP
				tag = PRU
			}
		}
		oe_heg2_is_mil_hegemon = yes
	}
}

# 5. Enlightened Reformer (1660+ stable high-rank powers embracing early modern institutions)
oe_aip_elig_enlightened_reformer = {
	current_year >= 1660
	stability >= 15
	war_exhaustion < 4
	OR = {
		is_great_power = yes
		country_rank_level >= 3
	}
	OR = {
		has_embraced_institution = institution:enlightenment
		has_embraced_institution = institution:scientific_revolution
		has_embraced_institution = institution:printing_press
	}
}

# 6. Concert Balancer (Pentarchy seat holder or balancing great power under high hegemonic tension)
oe_aip_elig_concert_balancer = {
	NOT = { oe_heg2_is_multi_hegemon = yes }
	OR = {
		oe_aip_has_concert_pentarchy_seat = yes
		AND = {
			oe_heg2_tension_high = yes
			is_great_power = yes
		}
	}
}

oe_aip_is_tracked_power = {
	OR = {

		tag = NED
		tag = HOL
		tag = GBR
		tag = ENG
		tag = FRA
		tag = SPA
		tag = HAB
		tag = PRU
		tag = BRA
		tag = POL
		tag = PLC
		tag = VEN
		tag = GEN
		tag = MAM
		tag = VIJ
		tag = DLH
		tag = MUG
		tag = BAH
		tag = GUJ
		tag = ZMR
		tag = MLC
		tag = JAP
		tag = ODA
		tag = ASK
		tag = KOR
	}
}

# Country scope. Currently carries any of the 6 v12.0 epic AI personalities.
oe_aip_has_any_epic_personality = {
	OR = {
		ai_personality = ai_personality:oe_aip_imperial_restorer
		ai_personality = ai_personality:oe_aip_thalassocracy_hegemon
		ai_personality = ai_personality:oe_aip_celestial_suzerain
		ai_personality = ai_personality:oe_aip_gunpowder_conqueror
		ai_personality = ai_personality:oe_aip_enlightened_reformer
		ai_personality = ai_personality:oe_aip_concert_balancer
	}
}
